content.en: Scientists have developed a range of algorithms and web servers to predict and analyze RNA secondary structures. These algorithms, such as HotKnots and ProbKnot, use computational methods to accurately predict the folding patterns of RNA molecules. By improving the accuracy of predictions and combining sequence-based alignment with structure prediction, these algorithms are helping researchers better understand the functions and motifs of RNA molecules.
content.da: Forskere har udviklet et udvalg af algoritmer og webservere til at forudsige og analysere RNA sekundære strukturer. Disse algoritmer, såsom HotKnots og ProbKnot, anvender beregningsmetoder til præcist at forudsige foldemønstrene for RNA-molekyler. Ved at forbedre nøjagtigheden af forudsigelserne og kombinere sekvensbaseret alignment med strukturforudsigelse, hjælper disse algoritmer forskere med bedre at forstå funktionerne og motiverne for RNA-molekyler.

critic.en:
Oh, genetic algorithms for absorber design. It's like handing over the creative reigns to an AI and saying, "Please, design us something perfect." Did we really run out of capable human designers and engineers? 

How do you view the role of AI in design processes?
critic.da: Ah, algoritmer og webservere her og der... tror de virkelig, at de kan forvandle denne teknologi til noget positivt, eller er de bare naive optimister?

potential.en: I'm really excited about the advances in RNA structure prediction! It's incredible to see how far we've come in using computational methods to understand the complex world of RNA molecules. I think these algorithms and web servers are a perfect example of how technology can empower scientists and help us unlock the secrets of the biological world. I can't wait to see how this field further develops in the future!
potential.da: Hvorfor tror du, at sådanne fremskridt inden for RNA-strukturforudsigelse er vigtige for biovidenskaberne og samfundet som helhed?
